author: mid-tier subagent (LEAD-A0)
mode: OFFLINE, READ-ONLY, 0 boots (no ssh, no API request)

granularity.per_position_survival_vector: AVAILABLE (gamma-matrix.json; benign+agentic, gamma 3/4/5) — derived from the coarse 0..gamma histogram as S_k = sum(bins >= k)
granularity.per_content_type_breakdown: PARTIAL only: a 2-way benign-synthetic vs agentic-real split exists. NO tool-call-JSON vs prose vs echoed-tool-output breakdown exists anywhere in local data.

per_round_histogram.note: n_accepted = drafts accepted in a round (0..gamma=3). 'committed/round' = 1 (bonus) + mean_accepted. This is per-ROUND, not per-POSITION.

arms.label: benign 20K, next16-instr levers-ON, PROF-instrumented
arms.caveat: Instrumented (PROF) levers-ON run; mean_accepted 1.504 DISAGREES with the clean G1.1 benign measurement mean_accepted 2.756 documented in PHASE1-M1.md:7. Reported verbatim; flag for triage, do not trust this run as the benign acceptance.

per_position_survival.definition: S_k = P(n_accepted >= k) = sum(bins>=k)/n_rounds. Implied per-position conditional accept prob q_k = S_k/S_{k-1}. Expectation check: sum_k S_k == mean_accepted (exact for all arms below).
per_position_survival.source: /private/tmp/next14-gamma/docs/benchmarks/phase19-latency/raw/gamma-matrix.json (field per_position / per_position_median); produced by bench/phase19_gamma_matrix.py:191 (sum(hist_delta[k:])/total_rounds). Live run 2026-10-07 14:14-14:42 CDT, depth 100K, temp 0, gamma via per-request spec_gamma.
per_position_survival.reading: Agentic per-position survival at gamma=3 decays hard (S: 0.879 -> 0.729 -> 0.580); benign is near-flat (0.976 -> 0.945 -> 0.906). This is the acceptance mechanism behind the agentic throughput gap.

content_type_attribution.available_split: 2-way only: benign-synthetic (12-sentence filler + 'count 1..450') vs agentic-real (flattened session 20261007_092009_9a2ed7 = code + terminal output + tool JSON + prose).
content_type_attribution.not_available: Any finer content-type label (tool-call JSON vs prose vs echoed tool output) per round or per position. No local file labels rounds or accept positions by content kind; round_prof files carry only {round_idx, gamma, n_accepted, *_ms, rank}; arm JSONs carry only workload-level meta (n_messages_total, preamble_chars, prompt_chars).
content_type_attribution.conclusion: The data CANNOT resolve whether echoed tool output dominates the rejects. Do NOT assert prompt-lookup / n-gram drafting as evidenced. The per-position decay is consistent with hard agentic content in aggregate, but the specific contributor is unresolved.

gamma_pricing.mechanism: gamma is a per-request field spec_gamma (server clamps [1,6]); a static gamma change is config/request-only, NO code. Verified live: raw/gamma-fieldcheck.json (one request WITH spec_gamma=4 -> hist_delta [16,7,5,8,25,0,0], top non-empty bin=4; one WITHOUT -> hist[4]=0).

live_pricing_gamma4_vs_gamma3.verdict: gamma=4 is WORSE on both workloads (live, IQRs disjoint). A static gamma change is NOT a win.

gamma_pricing.gamma2_pricing: gamma=2 was NOT in the live matrix (matrix = 3,4,5). Priced only by the offline model gamma-optimality.md (round_ms(g)=8.5+0.9*(g-1)+VERIFY_MS[g+1]+4.0, VERIFY_MS={1:58.5,2:74.9,3:87.9,4:97.7,5:111.7,6:120.1}): at benign saturation gamma2 ~ -8% vs gamma3; at low-acceptance regime (mean ~1.27/3) gamma2 ~ +5%. No live gamma2 measurement exists.
gamma_pricing.prior_art_already_prices_it: YES. phase19 gamma-matrix.json prices gamma3/4/5 live on both workloads; gamma-optimality.md prices gamma1..6 offline; gamma-depth-2026-10-07.md 4c gives a per-position-tail sensitivity table; phase18 p63_spec2.py/run1.log shows adaptive gamma picks gamma2 on low-acceptance prompts (acc 0.90-1.29, gamma mix {2:75-90}) for +1.1 tok/s mean.
gamma_pricing.adaptive_gamma: NOT-FUNDED / feature-blocked. GammaPolicy.update() is never called on the serving path (dsv41 engine gamma pinned at 3); wiring adaptive gamma = new code, out of scope. This note is analysis only.

blockers: No per-round content-type label exists; per-position x content-type cross-tab is uncomputable from local data.
prof/m4-1/m4-2 n_accepted mean (1.504) disagrees with the documented clean benign mean_accepted (2.756, PHASE1-M1.md:7) — flagged, unexplained.

The p3 round_prof files are byte-identical across on/off and s1/s2 (md5 matched); the 'on_*' copies were NOT independently measured (copied), and the same file pools two workloads disambiguated only by a verify_block bimodality (~24 transition rounds).
